entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I, uh, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. It's just... so confusing. I've read the user manual a couple of times, but the interface is really hard to use. Honestly, I expected more for the price. I've been a loyal customer for a while and I saved up for this... I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to be right for me.
I can certainly understand that frustration when a new gadget doesn't feel intuitive. Let me see what I can do. Can I get your full name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, order number 774-B2-901.
Thank you, Alex. Give me just one moment to pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 31 days ago, on December 19th.
Oh... is that going to be a problem? With the holidays and everything, I didn't get a real chance to try it until last week. I feel awful.

No need to feel awful at all. Let me just check the policy for you right now... (typing sounds) ... Okay, good news. I've checked our system, and your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
You can? Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I was stuck with it. That's such a relief. Thank you, Sarah!

You're very welcome, Alex. I'm happy I could help. I'm processing the return now and I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the tracker back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll see a full refund to your original payment method about 3 to 5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help. I really appreciate it.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, and have a great day.
You too, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
